description.value: An Indigenous-owned campground on the Shuswap River in central Enderby, offering 15 tent sites with full amenities — showers, laundry, camp store, kayak rentals — backed by the Enderby Cliffs; a social, activity-oriented stop with karaoke and movie nights rather than a quiet retreat.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active campground on the Shuswap River in Enderby, BC, with 15 tenting sites, 35 RV sites, and 4 yurts. Showers, laundry, water, and a camp store (ice, snacks, drinks, firewood) are explicitly listed. A 'BOOK NOW' button and online booking system confirm reservations are accepted. A pavilion is listed under amenities. No hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discounts, or bike-related amenities are mentioned. The site is Indigenous-owned and undergoing expansion.
concerns: No street address available in OSM or on the website; only 'Enderby, BC' can be confirmed.
No phone number found in OSM or on the fetched website pages.
OSM name uses 'Quilakwa RV & Campground' while the website header and branding alternate between 'Quilakwa RV & Campground' and 'Quilakwa RV Park & Campground' — minor inconsistency.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground in Enderby with tenting sites, showers, laundry, a camp store, and online booking — a solid stop for touring cyclists passing through the Shuswap/North Okanagan region.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email address rvpark@quilakwa.ca found on the cart subpage. The business also operates a second location, 'Quilakwa at the Lake Campground' at Mabel Lake, 35km outside Enderby — that is a separate facility and not covered by this listing.
